Freshness is evaluated from effective time against the active pack requirement, not server receipt time.

## Traceability

Task ID: ENG-BR-DATA-04; parent scope: SAHA-023; original requirement: BR-DATA-04; design ID: FR-DATA-04.
Work package: WP03; source original release: R1; source priority: Must.
Source accountable role: Workflow lead; named executor unassigned; estimate: Unestimated.
Source package dependencies: WP01 WP02. These are preserved design dependencies, not evidence of upstream completion.

## Inspect and adapt current implementation first

This is the preserved engineering outcome, not an instruction to rebuild an already implemented feature or adopt the original proposed architecture. Inspect current requirements/assessment.tsv, requirements/evidence-map.json, current API/data contracts, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` and `HANDOVER.md` in the current repository and related components/tests. Select verified reuse and record remaining behaviour. Freeze a minimal scoped execution contract before moving from Backlog.
Reference workbook components/APIs describe target design; actual current server identity, scoping, audit/version/receipt semantics remain authoritative. No schema/new store/provider/clinical-policy change is presumed.

## Acceptance and test output

Original named tests: TC-BR-DATA-04-A TC-BR-DATA-04-B. Exact positive/adverse fixtures, steps and expected results are preserved on the parent scope story. Original acceptance clauses and applicable NFR targets remain unchanged; original formal cases are Not run unless independently executed and accepted.
Done for this task requires a named published source/configuration, actual implementation or individually verified reuse, affected original/adverse checks, evidence of state/side effects/audit and limits, and separate final review. A narrower local witness cannot qualify the full parent. No estimates, approval signatures or test success is inferred from this import.

## Execution state and release

Backlog: current remaining scope must be qualified; historical source "Not started" is a reference snapshot, not a current claim that no code exists. Sponsor has held coding for full planning. GitHub #188 is the sole controller; D03 is the sole existing candidate, and no new story is dispatched. Clinical/partner/device/privacy prerequisites remain blockers where applicable.
Current demonstrations are synthetic only. No real recipients/patients, paid services, new hosting, secrets, providers, destructive migrations, parallel patient database or new clinical policies. Original requirements and release gates remain independent of bounded D01–D08 delivery.

[Parent story](<https://linear.app/aplyd-sandbox/issue/APL-46/saha-023-freshness-and-relevance>) · [Source engineering backlog](<https://github.com/nakul175/saha-health/blob/7668a03d97c1ae62174f09e65ccd5a5717120be6/docs/reference/workbook/Engineering-Backlog.csv>) · [Delivery gates](<https://linear.app/aplyd-sandbox/document/saha-story-readiness-and-delivery-gates-3fbcfc7ee2e7>)

## v4.2 planning refinement — source preserved

Author planning recommendation; the retained outcome and source acceptance remain unchanged. Do not weaken criteria to obtain a pass.

### Bounded handoff

* Parent contract: [APL-46 — \[SAHA-023\] Freshness and relevance](<https://linear.app/aplyd-sandbox/issue/APL-46/saha-023-freshness-and-relevance>)
* Inputs: The exact parent <issue id="536dc72e-cf9e-430d-8797-f2b97a7f6744" href="https://linear.app/aplyd-sandbox/issue/APL-46/saha-023-freshness-and-relevance">APL-46</issue> requirement/acceptance, source task/design ID, current implementation evidence and TC-BR-DATA-04-A, TC-BR-DATA-04-B.
* Reviewable output: Reviewable implementation or individually verified reuse demonstrating the preserved outcome: Freshness is evaluated from effective time against the active pack requirement, not server receipt time.
* Boundary: finish only this named outcome; no whole-parent or production qualification follows.

Native blockers: none recorded. Source package inspection inputs: WP01, WP02. Recommended remaining-work forecast: 1–3 engineering effort days, low confidence, conditional on verified reuse and a frozen bounded contract. Interface/device/source-gap tasks use the wider range; excludes external approval/observation wait and is not additional to the parent forecast.

### Verification and evidence

Upload an old measurement today or change a freshness rule during preparation. Use effective observation time and the approved version; stale data stays historical and cannot satisfy a new measurement.

Retain actual named check exits, source/config/fixture versions, before/after state, side effects, receipts/audit and unresolved limits for TC-BR-DATA-04-A, TC-BR-DATA-04-B. No planned test, historical source status or local narrow witness is a formal acceptance pass.

### Shared gates and delivery constraints
